about.title: Why this site?
about.description: Finding a flight time or price in the DRC often takes several phone calls. We gather that information in one place, route by route, so you can compare before you book.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: Make information about domestic flights in the DRC (airlines, schedules, prices) easy to find and compare.

approach.title: Where the data comes from
approach.description: Schedules and prices are collected from the airlines and then checked. Prices are indicative: the final fare is always confirmed by the airline or your agency at booking time.

expertise.title: What we are not
expertise.description: We are not an airline and we do not sell tickets.
